title: BATWA v2.4.12 Official Release
message: Naya update live ho chuka hai! Active 24/7 Cloudflare Gateway, 1Link/Raast auto account title fetch, dynamic 1Bill inquiry & receipts, authentic bank & telco logos, aur direct cards navigation shamil hain.
features: High-speed 24/7 Cloudflare Gateway connection to live Supabase backend
Automatic 1Link / Raast account title fetch with beneficiary save
Dynamic 1Bill inquiry & fixed payment receipts with strict length validation
Verified bank branding: ABL, Al Baraka, Soneri, BOK, DIB, Raqami, aik (BankIslami), Samba
Official HD Telecom logos for Jazz, Ufone, and Zong (Telenor removed)
Direct Cards tab navigation to virtual cards screen without popups
Compact analytics overview cards and clean dark green category breakdown bullets
Complete purge of pig/piggy bank icons and terms across the entire app
changelog: Configured dedicated high-speed Cloudflare Gateway with instant auth/ping clearance
Integrated 1Link title fetch in Bank Transfer eliminating manual receiver name typing
Dynamic hash-based 1Bill utility inquiry with verified consumer length validation
Updated bank & telco logos to authentic verified PNGs
Direct Cards tab navigation and streamlined analytics dashboard
